raw.comments: Repair only Tablet/PerfectSuperToBase.tex and the import preamble of Tablet/PerfectSuperToBase.lean. Preserve the theorem statement, conclusion, and support direction; add no helper and do not weaken the claim. Remove the unsupported Ext(y) existential equation and the auxiliary witnesses s,p,t,q obtained from it. For arbitrary x, retain the witnesses s0,p0 from FrontPrefixExists for x.1 and t0,q0 from FrontPrefixExists for (BaseShift X x).1. Unpack FrontPrefix (using FrontPrefix and ProperPrefixSet as needed) to obtain s0,t0 membership in F and the two proper-prefix relations. Apply the conditional statement of SuperSequenceExtension directly to (x,s0,p0) and to (BaseShift X x,t0,q0), explicitly deriving h x = f.value \<s0,p0.1\> and h (BaseShift X x) = f.value \<t0,q0.1\>. These same two equalities supply the theorem's required existential extension witness, so state that explicitly. Construct FiniteShift s0 t0 with witness x.1, rewrite the shifted range via BaseShift and ShiftMap, apply PerfectSuperSequence using s0.1, t0.1, and this witness, then rewrite with the two direct equalities to obtain BasePerfect. The FrontPrefixUnique detour is unnecessary; remove its citation and direct import if no longer used. Keep direct imports aligned with the cited supports, including FrontPrefixExists, BaseShift, FiniteShift, FrontPrefix, and ProperPrefixSet as required by the checker.
